style: Warm intimate historical oil-painting realism, cinematic visual-novel date-scene atmosphere, 2.25:1 wide. Three ordinary 16th-century sailors playing affectionately with a clearly visible animal on a wooden sailing ship; no text, borders, watermark or modern objects.
